source_audits.summary: A previous handoff package described a different delivery identity.
Legacy-only listing fallback was replaced by a generic marker despite the canonical fallback contract.
ADR/API documentation did not consistently state legacy fallback and structured precedence.
No explicit contradictory hybrid fixture proved structured identifiers win over legacy text.
Creating an account from a legitimate local loopback alias was rejected by the cookie mutation Origin guard before reaching the account route.

controls.evidence: The current handoff is being rebuilt after the material origin fix and will certify the new material head rather than the earlier result-only package.
The origin-only remediation does not touch the renderer; legacy-only listing fallback remains the already-minimized maskedIdentifier.
The contradictory hybrid regression remains unchanged and requires structured identifiers to win over legacy text.
API_ACCOUNTS.md and ADR 0012 remain aligned on structured precedence and legacy-only fallback.
The material fix accepts only localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] equivalence in local environments when protocol and port match; focused harness rejects different ports, non-loopback hosts and missing Origin.
